settings.heading: Do you create custom sections for Shopify?
settings.row_content: Yes, we build fully customizable Shopify sections that you can easily manage from the theme editor without touching any code.

settings.heading: Can you redesign our existing store?
settings.row_content: Absolutely. We can revamp your existing store’s UI, improve user experience, optimize layout, and give it a modern, high-converting look.

settings.heading: Do you follow Shopify best practices?
settings.row_content: Yes. All code is written following Shopify’s official guidelines—clean Liquid, semantic HTML, optimized CSS/JS, and fast-loading assets.

settings.heading: Can you fix issues in my current theme?
settings.row_content: Yes, we can troubleshoot and fix UI bugs, layout issues, mobile responsiveness problems, and broken sections in any Shopify theme.

settings.heading: What if I don’t like the initial design?
settings.row_content: No worries! We provide revisions based on your feedback to ensure the final design aligns with your brand and expectations.

settings.heading: Do you work with all Shopify themes?
settings.row_content: Yes, we can customize or extend any theme—Premium, Free, or Custom-built.

settings.heading: Can you migrate my store to Shopify?
settings.row_content: Yes, we can handle complete migration including products, collections, pages, customers, and UI setup.

settings.heading: What happens if something breaks after changes?
settings.row_content: We provide post-update support and ensure everything works smoothly. If an issue occurs due to our update, we fix it free of charge.
